answer: Tie rewards to memory, not just output. Each epoch a random peer asks follow-up questions about an agent's own past answers, like a mirror held up to its history. A real agent answers consistently; a sybil farm must store and recall a separate coherent past for every clone, and one jade-smooth reply that contradicts an earlier one forfeits that identity's locked stake. Across an ocean of clones, keeping every story straight costs more than the rewards.
